claims.statement: For the production bls12-381-fixed-g2-invert-g1 target, the algorithm in proof.md returns P in G1 with e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied uniform nonidentity Q and uniform z (P = infinity exactly for z = 1) with success at least 0.39 (modelled lower bound 0.3917 - 2^-48), conditional on H1-H5 of source-core.md. It computes g=e(P0,Q), exactly uniform on GT minus {1} and independent of z, maps g and z into the STNFS tower by the charged field map of proof.md, computes a=log_g(z) with the GT STNFS core (REVISION.md R1-R19, R21: 99.9% ECM, theta 719/2000, slacks 293/224, 10.005 route, 20/13-entry LA, 22x4 blocks, exact prices, 0.05% reserve, N/U 0.0663, meter 118.75286, split 2^48, band-strip, re-optimised plan) and returns P=[a]P0 after checking e(P,Q)=z. Core ledger below 2^121.25689 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000). Total classical work (preprocessing, both logarithms, failures, field map, pairings, verification, output) is at most (2001/2000) x 2^121.25689 + 2^80/20000 < 2^121.257611167243655 units. Storage < 2^106 bytes; no advice/amortization. Analytic claim.

experiments.purpose: Recomputes from shipped code+data every REVISION.md quantity (region, counts, yield/margin, work SE/allowance, ECM, R3 route, R4 finishing, LA/generator, descent, counter/repeats, success, ledger) and the recover-P total. Skips unchanged inherited certificates.
Optional recomputation of all inherited certificates plus the revised model and declared bounds.

title: Recover P via the revised GT STNFS core with triples plan re-search (R21): 121.257611167243655
